Its evidence document had CLAIMED the occlusion half while the result file recorded five of six cases, so nothing was taken on trust: tests/probe_cd007_occlusion_target.gd puts a real second vehicle BEHIND the wall, fires the external HE at the wall from outside, and reads the target own state. All three claims in the document are therefore confirmed by measurement rather than restated.
